description: Turn a range of git commits into concise, accurate release notes. Groups changes by user impact, calls out breaking changes, upgrade steps, and migration requirements. Trigger on requests like "write the changelog", "what's new in this release", "release notes for v1.3.0", "summarize what shipped", or "draft the changelog for this version".
